whenToUse: Brief feedback after an action, such as a created event or an archived message with Undo
Progress of async work in one toast that updates in place, from loading to success or failure
Rich notifications for messages, invites, deploys, builds and integrations, with their own buttons

whenNotToUse.when: A status or warning that must stay on the page until the problem is fixed
A choice the user has to make before the page can carry on
An inbox panel that lists past activity for the user to review on demand

agentNotes: The examples ship only the sonner package and never render `Toaster`; mount the shadcn sonner `Toaster` once near your app root or no `toast` shows
